semantic_findings.name: Camera.set_mode
semantic_findings.finding: Returns zero immediately without reading arguments or modifying camera state. It is not a functional switch to a native first-person mode.

semantic_findings.name: Camera.set_post_projection_transform
semantic_findings.finding: Binding reads two Lua arguments and calls a substantive native camera transform function. This establishes a real per-camera operation, not a weapon-only projection pass.

semantic_findings.name: Camera.set_projection_type
semantic_findings.finding: Writes camera+0x30 and invokes a native recalculation; exact allowed values, lifecycle and game ownership are not qualified.

semantic_findings.name: Unit.set_animation_merge_options
semantic_findings.finding: Substantive Unit-resolving wrapper reaches native animation interfaces. Argument meanings, graph constraints and suitability for this FPS rig are unqualified.

next_native_fp_questions.question: Preserve native FP camera/rig co-motion and native recoil rather than reconstructing view rotation.
next_native_fp_questions.status: Existing camera pin removal and native forwarding are separate implementation work; no alternative writer qualified here.

next_native_fp_questions.question: Qualify native input axes, controller behavior and an exact pre-zoom input boundary without changing saved sensitivity.
next_native_fp_questions.status: Input runtime instances appear in historical census; current build function/instance census and field semantics still required.

next_native_fp_questions.question: Determine whether viewmodel projection can be separated from world projection and near clipping.
next_native_fp_questions.status: Names and many wrappers proven; no independent first-person render pass, per-weapon FOV or render ownership proven.

next_native_fp_questions.question: Use native animation/constraint/merge/root/bone controls where they preserve full animated weapon coherence.
next_native_fp_questions.status: Registration coverage established; meaning and native graph/weapon restrictions need per-function investigation. Do not call all setters experimentally.

next_native_fp_questions.question: Use native pass/visibility APIs for arms/gun shadows, body occlusion and environment effects.
next_native_fp_questions.status: Visibility/settings already used by candidate with separate contracts; RenderDataComponent generic get/set registration uses a different template and remains outside this extractor.

next_native_fp_questions.question: Resolve action, death, vehicle, player/weapon handoff through the game camera/animation state machines.
next_native_fp_questions.status: No public set-first-person gameplay controller exposed by the searched 1,874-path census; proprietary game.dll camera FSM and action-specific transitions still need analysis. This is a bounded negative, not proof of absence.
